value.claim: By [F1], the tensor-product counit is $\varepsilon_{kG}\otimes\varepsilon_{k[x]}$. The group-algebra counit has $\varepsilon_{kG}(g)=1$, while the polynomial counit is a unital algebra map with $\varepsilon_{k[x]}(x)=0$ by [F2], so it takes $1=x^0$ to $1$ and $x^n$ to $0$ for $n>0$. Therefore $\varepsilon(g\otimes x^n)=1$ for $n=0$ and $0$ for $n>0$, as claimed.
